summary_bullets: Add a Step 2b post-plan emit driver that preserves emit, snapshot, validator, and pause contracts
Route initial and re-emit design prose through the shared post-plan handoff
Cover the driver and structural call-site migration with offline harness pins
commit_message:
Extract design post-plan emit driver

Add design-postplan-emit.sh to run EMIT_PLAN, the optional HARD snapshot, and plan-command validation behind one result-env contract. Rewire Step 2b and prompt-side re-emit prose to use the driver while preserving file-first/stdout parsing, defects-found routing, quick-mode parity, and pause checkpoints.

Add offline driver coverage and migrate structural pins plus Makefile wiring for the new harness.
